question.title: Buy the vacation cabin?
question.background: Family of five, single income, stable job. Cabin is 2.5h drive, asking price ~= 1.1x our annual gross income, 20% down available without touching retirement. Intended use: ~20 weekends/yr. Local rental comps would cover ~60% of carrying costs if rented 8 weeks/yr. Question: will we, one year after purchase, judge the purchase to have been the right call?

resolution.criteria: Asker records a yes/no judgment 12 months after purchase (or records 'did not buy').
